I mean it is a question...
Does anyone even use RPG Maker 2000 anymore?  Hell, NO ONE USES 95. Hahah. Too old.

Danny's Adventures 1 and 2
Nightmare of the Elven World
Legend of the Sacred Fish
Call of the Archon

posts.author: Lunacero
posts.body:
Grimms Hollow was made in RM2k3. But that was released in... 2019? So not exactly new.
Sheesh, it's like time is on fast-forward since 2020.
When a game is good, most won't care which engine it is made in.
But I love 2k/2k3. They were my introduction to RPG Maker and still have a lot of potential. Especially if you're making your own art.
If you like it, you should keep using it
It's a great engine.
